_doc: Audit allowlist for known tech-debt vulnerabilities. Each entry MUST have severity, reason, and expires (YYYY-MM-DD). Expired entries become BLOCKING violations. See .github/scripts/audit-gate.py.

@xmldom/xmldom.reason: Transitive XML parser; no drop-in patch in current lockfile — track upgrade with calendar/iCal consumers

axios.reason: Shared HTTP client across apps; minor bumps need API smoke — coordinate with backend turismo clients

body-parser.reason: Express stack transitive; upgrade bundled with backend express security PR

brace-expansion.reason: Toolchain transitive (glob/minimatch); no direct prod dependency

browserslist.reason: Toolchain transitive; bump coordinated with Next/Autoprefixer matrix

dompurify.reason: Root pin for HTML sanitization; upgrade requires turismo/site-publico XSS regression pass

engine.io.reason: Socket.IO server transitive; bump with realtime stack upgrade

engine.io-client.reason: Socket.IO client transitive; bump with socket.io major alignment

express.reason: Backend API framework pin; upgrade via dedicated express security PR with route smoke

follow-redirects.reason: Axios/http transitive; resolves with coordinated axios bump

handlebars.reason: Template engine transitive (mail/reporting); upgrade pending template regression tests

minimatch.reason: Glob toolchain transitive; dev/build only paths

multer.reason: Upload middleware used by anfitrião trilho/gallery; upgrade pending API-compatible release

next.reason: Framework pin shared across apps; upgrade via dedicated Next security PR (not this feature branch)

nodemailer.reason: Mail transport pin; upgrade pending regression tests on notification templates

proxy-addr.reason: Express trust-proxy transitive; fix with express stack security PR

sharp.reason: Image pipeline transitive via Next; bump with Next major alignment

source-map-js.reason: Build tooling transitive; no direct runtime exposure

ws.reason: Socket.IO websocket transitive; bump with socket.io major alignment

xlsx.reason: SheetJS without npm patch; migrate to exceljs or SheetJS CDN (issue #42)

zod.reason: Shared validation v3; npm audit fix targets zod v4 breaking — dedicated schema migration PR
